title: Xdrip variant crash
body:
Xdrip variant 1,  13.10.2021. and also 4.10.2021. when I go to settings, alarm and alerts, glucose level alert list xdrip crash and restart. Same behavior on settings for missed reading alert.
Also xdrip variants don't have separate names like they have before. Both xdrip on my phone have the same name, just :xdrip. Before there will be xdrip and xdrip variant 1 for example. This is important because I can't identify from whom is glucose level in notification area. In variants from June 2021 names are ok and xdrip don't crash on alerts settings.

Thank you for your work.

comments.body:
@adenis76   Thank for catching and reporting this.
I confirm that I see the crash with variant 1 for October 13.

Would you please confirm that you have experienced the crash only with October 4 and October 13?
Or, have you experienced the crash with any other release?
@tolot27 Could it be?  The crash only happens on the variant.
yes I think there is something wrong with the automated build process.  I will investigate.

> @adenis76 Thank for catching and reporting this. I confirm that I see the crash with variant 1 for October 13.
> 
> Would you please confirm that you have experienced the crash only with October 4 and October 13? Or, have you experienced the crash with any other release?

I can confirm crash on 02.09.2021; 18.08.2021; 17.08.2021; 16.08.2021; 04.08.2021; 02.08.2021; 

This variant versions also have same name, only xdrip

Version 31.07.2021 work ok and have different name, xdrip variant 1. Version from 17.07.2021, 10.07.2021,  02.07.2021, 28.06.2021, 19.06.2021, also work ok.

> @adenis76 Thanks, I can confirm that I see what you are describing with the names looking exactly the same after install for the recent variants. Again, thanks for reporting and identifying which versions this happens to.

Thank you and other developers for your work. Xdrip make our life easier, give our child's freedom and is lifesaver.

June 11, 2021, variants 1 and 2: ![Screenshot_20211013-123759](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/51497406/137177875-4aa4fca1-a4e9-4927-990f-5000f8a88efd.jpg) As can be seen in the snapshot, the variants are distinctly marked.
October 13, 2021, variants 3 and 4: ![Screenshot_20211013-123850](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/51497406/137178020-5f8e83ad-14e8-4e5d-86fe-75098735e4dc.jpg) In this case, the variants look identical and there is no way of telling them apart.

Try these updated binaries. I think this should resolve the issue:
https://github.com/NightscoutFoundation/xDrip/releases/tag/2021.10.13-variants

> Try these updated binaries. I think this should resolve the issue: https://github.com/NightscoutFoundation/xDrip/releases/tag/2021.10.13-variants

Work's great. I can open all settings without crash and this version have different name.
Thank you.
